description: This file implements logging functionalities for the lighttpd server, including timestamp handling, writing logs to various outputs, and formatting log messages with support for syslog and Windows-specific error handling.

methods.name: log_clock_gettime
methods.description: Retrieves the current time with support for different clock types and platform-specific implementations.

methods.name: log_clock_gettime_realtime
methods.description: Gets the current real-time clock value.

methods.name: write_all
methods.description: Writes data to a file descriptor, retrying on interruptions until all data is written or an error occurs.

methods.name: log_buffer_tstr
methods.description: Caches a formatted timestamp string for logging.

methods.name: log_buffer_timestamp
methods.description: Appends a timestamp to a buffer, supporting high-precision or standard formats.

methods.name: log_buffer_prefix
methods.description: Prepends filename and line number information to a log buffer.

methods.name: log_buffer_isprint_ascii_len
methods.description: Calculates the length of printable ASCII characters in a string.

methods.name: log_buffer_isprint_utf8_len
methods.description: Calculates the length of printable UTF-8 characters in a string.

methods.name: log_buffer_append_encoded
methods.description: Appends a string to a buffer, encoding non-printable characters.

methods.name: log_buffer_vsprintf
methods.description: Formats a string with variable arguments and appends it to a buffer, encoding non-printable characters.

methods.name: log_buffer_prepare
methods.description: Prepares a buffer for logging, including timestamp and prefix.

methods.name: log_error_write
methods.description: Writes a log buffer to the configured output, either syslog or file descriptor.

methods.name: log_error_append_winerror
methods.description: Appends Windows system error messages to a log buffer.

methods.name: log_error_append_strerror
methods.description: Appends a string representation of an error number to a log buffer.

methods.name: log_va_list
methods.description: Formats and logs a message with variable arguments, including error information.

methods.name: log_debug
methods.description: Logs a debug message.

methods.name: log_error
methods.description: Logs an error message.

methods.name: log_perror
methods.description: Logs an error message with perror-style error string.

methods.name: log_serror
methods.description: Logs a Windows-specific error message.

methods.name: log_pri
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified syslog priority.

methods.name: log_pri_multiline
methods.description: Logs multiline messages with a specified priority.

methods.name: log_set_global_errh
methods.description: Sets the global error handler for logging.

methods.name: log_buffer_isprint_init
methods.description: Initializes the function used to determine printable characters, supporting ASCII or UTF-8.
